name: BACH_0181
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class prediction set and 0% invasive risk support routine reading [F1], though three of five nearest neighbors are InSitu.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 99%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0%, Normal 0% | Strongly favors Benign over InSitu |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (alpha 10%, 90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th percentile OOD, 10 regions kept [F6] | Passes QC despite atypical appearance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign (40%), 3/5 InSitu [F5] | Mixed neighbors; three are InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.52, contribution -0.97) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · High duct-confinement score (+1.62, contribution -0.92) opposes invasion [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.48, contribution +0.88), failed 0/20 spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Below-average score (-0.21, contribution +0.52) slightly increases invasive score · Validated
- **HoVer-Net nuclear measurements** (regions 0, 1, 10) · context · 83% neoplastic nuclei (99th percentile) [F7], small 46 µm² nuclei [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability beyond random (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Duct-confined atypia in regions 1, 9, 11 represents InSitu carcinoma, matching three of five nearest neighbors (82% similarity).
- High heatmap risk in region 0 (78%) and 3,008/mm² neoplastic density [F8] reflect focal lesion diluted across regions.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 0**: Inspect highest-risk region (78%) with 126 neoplastic nuclei and 90th-percentile nuclear size variation [F10].
2. **Regions 1, 9, 11**: Evaluate duct-confined proliferation (scores 1.47–1.84) to rule out InSitu carcinoma.
3. **Region 10**: Confirm intact stromal borders where 113 neoplastic and 20 connective nuclei interface.
